central_claim: The paper's Lipschitz-driven method achieves nominal 95% coverage for confidence intervals in spatial association estimation, while competing methods (OLS, Sandwich, KDEIW, GLS, GP BCIs) fail to achieve this coverage.
claim_evidence: Abstract states 'Our approach is the first to guarantee nominal coverage in this setting and outperforms existing techniques in both real and simulated experiments.' Figure 1 (combined_plot_simulation) shows the proposed method and GP BCIs consistently achieve nominal coverage while other methods fail.

Run with: python two_dim_shift.py --num_seeds=250 --n=300 --m=100 --noise_std=0.1 --num_neighbors=1 --lipschitz_bound=2.828 --num_threads=36

dataset_available.evidence: The MRE can use D-NeRF, which is publicly supported by Nerfstudio's dataset downloader; the opened Nerfstudio documentation explicitly lists `ns-download-data dnerf` for downloading the full D-NeRF dynamic synthetic scenes dataset and lists D-NeRF as an 8-scene dataset. The paper also evaluates NeRF-DS, whose original public GitHub repository was opened and shows a public repository with a Dynamic Specular Dataset Release, but the chosen MRE uses D-NeRF.

weights_available.evidence: No HAIF-GS checkpoints, Gaussian point-cloud outputs, model weights, or Hugging Face model pages were found after searches for HAIF-GS checkpoint, HAIF-GS weights, HAIF-GS model, HAIF-GS Hugging Face, and site:huggingface.co HAIF-GS. The paper text does not provide a checkpoint link, and no OpenReview supplement is present in the input.

dataset_is_standard.evidence: D-NeRF is a widely used public benchmark for dynamic NeRF/dynamic novel-view-synthesis papers. It is listed by Nerfstudio among built-in existing datasets with a one-command downloader and is the synthetic dynamic benchmark used by this paper and many cited dynamic NeRF/3DGS baselines.

agent_task: Clone the HAIF-GS GitHub repository (github.com/EchoPickle/HAIF-GS), install required dependencies (PyTorch, Gaussian Splatting libraries as specified in the paper), download the D-NeRF dataset from github.com/albertpumarola/D-NeRF, and train HAIF-GS on the Hook scene for 30k iterations. Evaluate PSNR on the test set and compare with the paper's reported 39.38 dB.

h100_estimate.basis: Single-scene training on D-NeRF at 800x800 resolution. Paper states experiments use 'single NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU'. Estimated ~8 hours per scene for ~10k iterations based on comparable dynamic 3DGS methods. RTX 3090 equivalent to A100 80GB is 0.32x H100 rate. Conversion: 1 GPU * 8 hours * 0.32 = 2.56 H100-hours. Engineering/debugging time to implement HAIF-GS from scratch (since no code released) is additional and significant.
